meta.src:
schema: playbook/2
name: component_aZzBN7D0j0KWVIPdU_playbook
title: component_aZzBN7D0j0KWVIPdU_playbook
actions:
  Get_Records_Parallel:
    title: Get Records Parallel
    type: parallelGroup
    description: >
      Retrieves enabled signal rules and current SIG record in parallel to optimize performance.
    on-success:
    - Rule_Evaluator: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    entrypoints:
    - Get_Enabled_Signal_Rules
    - Get_Current_CASE_Record
    actions:
      Get_Enabled_Signal_Rules:
        title: Get Enabled CASE Rules
        type: recordAction
        description: >
          Searches for active CASE rules that are enabled and have defined conditions for evaluation.
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        inputs:
          applicationId: aHIKL4OPed1qTNWcV
          limit: 1000
          returnFields:
          - rule-name
          - rule-order
          - conditions
          - tracking-id
          - rule-uuid
          filters:
          - fieldId: ayfuj
            filterType: equals
            value: 691214ef57894b4e6e5b4a8a
          - fieldId: abt93
            filterType: doesNotEqual
            value: 
          filterType: AND
          applicationName: ""
        recordActionType: search
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
      Get_Current_CASE_Record:
        meta: {}
        title: Get Current CASE Record
        type: recordAction
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        description: >
          Retrieves the current CASE record using the provided CASE Tracking ID input.
        inputs:
          applicationName: ""
          applicationId: aGLUPEw5Z3dKNx0wk
          filters:
          - fieldId: 6933610b634a141219c0926e
            filterType: equals
            value: '{ $:ref: $inputs.CASE_Tracking_ID }'
          filterType: AND
          returnFields: []
          limit: 1000
        recordActionType: search
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Rule_Evaluator:
    title: Rule Evaluator
    type: connector
    description: >
      Evaluates SIG records against signal rules to identify matches based on defined conditions.
    on-success:
    - Get_Values: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    action: $playbook.component_aZ1LRHkhdRw0Pruxj_playbook
    inputs:
      Records_to_Evaluate:
        $:ref: $actions.Get_Current_CASE_Record.result.records
      Rules_to_Evaluate_Against:
        $:ref: $actions.Get_Enabled_Signal_Rules.result.records
    pool: $default
    testInputs: {}
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    asset: ""
    environment: {}
  Matching_Rule_UUID_Exists:
    title: Matching Rule UUID Exists
    type: conditional
    description: >
      Checks if a matching rule UUID was found during evaluation to determine next steps.
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    conditions:
    - action: Update_CASE_Record
      condition:
        $:and:
        - $:not:
          - $:ref: $actions.Get_Values.result.matching_rule_uuid
          - $:empty: true
    else: ""
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 45c1148c-3a66-4109-a3e0-aee6361e097d
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Execute_Rule:
    title: Execute Rule
    type: emitEvent
    description: >
      Emits event to trigger execution of the matched rule using Rule UUID and Tracking ID.
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    inputs:
      eventData:
        Rule_UUID: '{ $:ref: $actions.Get_Values.result.matching_rule_uuid }'
        Tracking_ID: "{ $:ref: $actions.Get_Current_CASE_Record.result.records[0]['tracking-id'] }"
      sensorName: Rule_Execute
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Get_Values:
    meta: {}
    title: Get Values
    type: transformation
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success:
    - Matching_Rule_UUID_Exists: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: >
      Extracts record ID, matching rule details, UUID, and tracking ID from evaluation results.
    transformations:
      matching_rule:
        title: Matching Rule
        inputs:
          data:
            actions:
              Rule_Evaluator:
                result:
                  published:
                    Rule_Matches:
                      $:ref: $actions.Rule_Evaluator.result.published.Rule_Matches
          expression: $lookup(actions.Rule_Evaluator.result.published.Rule_Matches[0],'matching_rule')
        next: matching_rule_uuid
        description: ""
        display:
          functions:
          - function: lookup
            inputs:
            - $:ref: $actions.Rule_Evaluator.result.published.Rule_Matches[0]
            - matching_rule
          advancedView: false
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
        actionType: jsonata
        testInputs:
          data: {}
          expression: ""
      matching_rule_uuid:
        title: Matching Rule UUID
        inputs:
          data:
            actions:
              Get_Values:
                result:
                  matching_rule:
                    $:ref: $actions.Get_Values.result.matching_rule
          expression: $lookup(actions.Get_Values.result.matching_rule,'rule-uuid')
        next: matching_rule_tracking_id
        description: ""
        display:
          functions:
          - function: lookup
            inputs:
            - $:ref: $actions.Get_Values.result.matching_rule
            - rule-uuid
          advancedView: false
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
        actionType: jsonata
        testInputs:
          data: {}
          expression: ""
      matching_rule_tracking_id:
        title: Matching Rule Tracking ID
        inputs:
          data:
            actions:
              Get_Values:
                result:
                  matching_rule:
                    $:ref: $actions.Get_Values.result.matching_rule
          expression: $lookup(actions.Get_Values.result.matching_rule,'tracking-id')
        next: rule_last_processed
        description: ""
        display:
          functions:
          - function: lookup
            inputs:
            - $:ref: $actions.Get_Values.result.matching_rule
            - tracking-id
          advancedView: false
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
        actionType: jsonata
        testInputs:
          data: {}
          expression: ""
      case_record_id:
        title: CASE Record ID
        inputs:
          expression: $lookup(actions.Rule_Evaluator.result.published.Rule_Matches[0],'record_id')
          data:
            actions:
              Rule_Evaluator:
                result:
                  published:
                    Rule_Matches:
                      $:ref: $actions.Rule_Evaluator.result.published.Rule_Matches
        next: matching_rule
        description: ""
        display:
          functions:
          - function: lookup
            inputs:
            - $:ref: $actions.Rule_Evaluator.result.published.Rule_Matches[0]
            - record_id
          advancedView: false
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
        actionType: jsonata
        testInputs:
          data: {}
          expression: ""
      rule_last_processed:
        title: Rule Last Processed
        description: ""
        display:
          functions:
          - function: dateParseBasic
            inputs:
            - Current Time
            - 
            - 
            - 
            - 
          advancedView: false
        inputs:
          expression: $dateParseBasic('Current Time',null,null,null,null)
          data: {}
        testInputs:
          data: {}
          expression: ""
        actionType: jsonata
        next: ""
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
    entrypoint: case_record_id
    inputSchemaReferenceId: fee7a85e-1a03-427f-8326-b505c924b376
    outputSchemaReferenceId: 399ce71b-b0ec-41aa-b00d-d8c810575440
    errorSchemaReferenceId: 84186e34-8c89-4015-a34f-5bf72d43cdb8
  Update_CASE_Record:
    meta: {}
    title: Update CASE Record
    type: recordAction
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success:
    - Execute_Rule: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: >
      Updates CASE record with matched rule reference, UUID, and sets processing status to 'Processing'.
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 267808b3-a9e0-4ebc-8213-ef7f335dec0c
    inputs:
      applicationName: ""
      applicationId: aGLUPEw5Z3dKNx0wk
      trackingId: "{ $:ref: $actions.Get_Current_CASE_Record.result.records[0]['tracking-id'] }"
      patchValues:
        rule-processed-reference:
        - '{ $:ref: $actions.Get_Values.result.matching_rule_tracking_id }'
        rule-processing-status: Processing
        rule-matched: '{ $:ref: $actions.Get_Values.result.matching_rule_uuid }'
        rule-last-processed: '{ $:ref: $actions.Get_Values.result.rule_last_processed }'
      removeValues: {}
      appendValues: {}
      restrictions:
        users:
          operation: append
          value: []
        groups:
          operation: append
          value: []
    recordActionType: patch
meta:
  enabled: true
description: ""
namespace: $default
entrypoints:
- Get_Records_Parallel
pool: ""
timeout: 0
publish:
  Records_Matched:
    $:ref: $actions.Rule_Evaluator.result.published.Records_Matched
environment: {}
triggers: {}
inputSchemaReferenceId: 0df3b949-2459-4e76-9c10-ef61c35ab927
outputSchemaReferenceId: 759ac706-e207-4226-a922-406f26af8fb6
publishSchemaReferenceId: e474c388-48aa-4f86-a11b-652b6804fbd1

  type: object
